task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First, it would be great if you could make an effort to go to the south. Once you accomplish that, make an attempt to move east. And then, head south. Next, go south. After that, make an effort to go to the south. After that, attempt to move east. After that, move north. That done, head north. If you can manage that, recover the keycard from the basket. That's it!
